descripcion: At C2 a summary is calibrated to what the specific audience already knows, compressing shared background aggressively while expanding exactly the part that's genuinely new to them — the same source material summarised differently for two different audiences.

filas: why it matters, in plain terms
a short bridge naming both readings

ejemplos.texto: Skipping the methodology, which you'll know already, the one real surprise was the effect size.
In plain terms, this means prices are likely to rise faster than expected.
For those new to this, here's the one thing that actually matters.

notas: Naming what you're skipping (skipping the methodology, which you'll know already) signals respect for an expert audience's time.
The same source can be summarised in two genuinely different ways depending on the audience, not just simplified once for everyone.
For a general audience, expanding why it matters in plain terms is more valuable than expanding technical detail they didn't ask for.

contraste.es: Spanish professional prose rarely restructures a summary around what a specific audience already knows; the same account tends to be retold in roughly the same order regardless of listener. English readers expect that recalibration by default, so a Spanish speaker who summarises the whole thing every time reads as failing to gauge the room, not as being thorough.

errores: Giving the same summary regardless of audience, wasting an expert's time or losing a general reader.
Compressing the one part that's actually new to this audience.
Expanding technical detail for an audience that needs the implications instead.

redemittel.funcion: expands implications for a general audience

traducciones.es: Para quienes son nuevos en esto,…

redemittel.expresion: The part that actually matters here is…

traducciones.es: La parte que realmente importa acá es…

redemittel.expresion: I'll assume you know…, so let's focus on…

traducciones.es: Voy a asumir que conocen…, así que enfoquémonos en…

autochequeo: Is the summary calibrated to what this specific audience already knows?
Is shared background compressed, not repeated at length?
Is the genuinely new or significant part expanded, not buried?
Would an expert feel their time was respected?
Would a general reader understand why it matters?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on whether the summary is calibrated to the intended audience's existing knowledge. Check what's compressed versus expanded. Do not rewrite the text.
